finding: Cross-functional commercial/cost role spans estimating, procurement, finance and project control.
Pre-contract estimating role requires dedicated work-product composition across F07/F09.
Current generated architecture splits one employable job across initiation, execution and closure profiles.
Construction Project Manager is a partial base but site execution work products span project, field, QHSE, logistics and information.
No direct sector Job Profile exists in the generated function-derived baseline.
Existing Architect titles are IT/enterprise architecture roles, not built-environment architectural practice.
No direct professional MEP/building-services Job Profile exists.
No direct professional building-surveying Job Profile exists.
F22 Facilities Manager is useful but requires explicit asset, maintenance, compliance, contractor, budget and service work products.
Employable procurement management role composes strategy, sourcing, contracting, supplier and operational work.
Construction contract administration spans sales/commercial negotiation, legal contract management and controlled contract records.
Generated Project Planner is a useful direct base but requires explicit WBS, schedule, baseline, progress and delay work products.
Generated Project Controls Manager is a useful base but must compose finance, risk, change and reporting work products outside F27.
No single Project Accountant profile; the employment job composes cost accounting, close, reporting and project financial-control context.
No built-environment Design Manager employment profile exists; the role spans information requirements, planning, review, coordination, change and handover.
No direct built-environment Civil Engineer Job Profile exists.
No direct built-environment Structural Engineer Job Profile exists.
No direct regulatory Building Control Officer Job Profile exists.
The employable H&S management role composes framework, risk, inspection, permit and incident responsibilities.
Quality management spans planning, assurance, inspection, NCR/defect, CAPA, supplier quality and reporting.
Environmental management requires both operational environmental control and compliance/return responsibilities.
Asset management spans strategy, information, criticality/condition, investment, maintenance and disposal.
Maintenance planning requires preventive planning plus reactive/backlog and resource/parts coordination.
No direct trade Electrician Job Profile exists despite the role requiring estimate, field execution, testing, certification, asset and maintenance work.
No direct trade Plumber Job Profile exists despite end-to-end survey, quote, installation, testing, asset and service work.
No direct plant-operator Job Profile exists; the role requires mobile allocation, checks, utilisation, defects, progress and safety evidence.
No direct built-environment acoustics employment profile exists; the role spans environmental monitoring, specialist modelling, design advice, verification and statutory/client reporting.
No direct architectural-technology profile exists; technical production crosses controlled information, coordination, site response, revision and handover.
No direct Architectural Technologist profile exists; the role spans technical design strategy, compliance, specialist authoring, review, change and site assurance.
No direct Building Technician profile exists; survey, drawing, schedules, inspection, defects and completion work cross property, information and project functions.
No direct Cartographer profile exists; spatial datasets, mapping, metadata, QA, issue and exchange require a dedicated geospatial work-product composition.
No direct Civil Engineering Technician profile exists; the job composes survey data, connected design authoring, site measurement, inspection and as-built handover.
Energy Manager is adjacent but does not represent regulated commercial assessment, evidence, calculation/model, rating, certificate, correction and lodgement work.
Energy Manager is adjacent but does not represent dwelling assessment, approved-method calculation, certificate, supersession and lodgement work.
No direct Engineering Construction Technician profile exists; work spans technical work packs, traceability, installation, testing, commissioning, defects and handover.
No direct Fire Safety Engineer profile exists; the employment role combines specialist design/analysis, compliance, risk, inspection, testing and formal fire-safety handover.
Property acquisition and lease profiles are useful partial sources but do not cover valuation, inspection, appraisal, transactions and portfolio advice as one employable job.
No direct Geospatial Technician profile exists; the role requires spatial capture, CRS/control, datasets, maps, metadata, QA, versioning and exchange.
No direct Heritage Officer profile exists; heritage asset records, significance assessment, consent cases, consultation, inspections, conditions and monitoring cross several functions.
No direct Land Surveyor profile exists; survey control, raw observations, spatial models, setting out, boundary records, QA and as-built handover require dedicated composition.
No direct Landscape Architect profile exists; landscape site analysis, specialist design, planting/specification, coordination, inspection, change and maintenance handover span multiple functions.
Capital planning and property acquisition are partial sources; the employment role additionally requires planning constraints, development appraisal/valuation, case negotiation and obligations.
Property, lease and disposal profiles are partial sources but do not form the complete rural estate, valuation, tenancy, works and compensation role.
No direct Surveying Technician profile exists; field measurement, survey datasets, drawings, quantities, inspections, QA and reports require a cross-functional composition.
No direct Town Planner profile exists; the job requires planning cases, spatial/policy assessment, consultation, recommendations, conditions, appeals/enforcement and monitoring.
Transport Manager is adjacent but does not represent transport survey, demand/network modelling, appraisal, planning assessment, mitigation and monitoring work.
